newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 50,000 tonnes of wheat for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 50,000 tonnes of wheat for sale.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has offered 50,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for sale, a company spokesman said on Monday.
He told Reuters that an international call for prices setting October 15 as final date to receive price offers had already been issued. Confirmation would be made on October 16.
The amount would be ready for shipment in November, he added.
Earlier on Monday, the GECPT also offered 100,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for sale, with October 29 as final date to receive price offers and confirmation on October 30.
The wheat in the first tender was for shipment in December.
